support: uniform empirical distribution of the pinned released1200-row vaccine attribute difference support
truth: same frozen converged11-coordinate logit simulation parameter as the earlier finite-pool benchmark
prediction_formula: expit(a * correct conditional log odds given X,Z + b)
ridge_convention: rho=1/m on every coordinate; this changes the objective
soft_pool_scope: uses the same frozen prediction as other methods; only the oracle case has correct conditional mean
matching: all methods and prediction cases share each generated covariate, true choice, proxy and sample size; human fits are shared
intervals: same diagnostic marginal Wald sandwich convention as earlier; no penalization-bias correction or finite-sample guarantee
outputs: mean and tail parameter/choice loss errors
paired contrasts and Monte Carlo error
scope: known-truth IID choice-row simulation, no new real respondent or LLM data; not a registered human experiment or causal version comparison
stopping: fixed500; no optional stopping or selection by performance
